attempts.prompt: Clean illustrated lineup of three women's head-and-shoulders portraits on a light neutral background, each with the same square face shape. The three cuts are a long side-swept fringe with mid-length layers, a layered lob ending below the jaw, and a curly textured pixie with volume at the crown, each with a small one-word label underneath.
issues: Brief asks for a 'clean illustrated' lineup, but the image is photorealistic portraits, not illustration.

The three panels are not cleanly separated: the left panel's hair and shoulders touch or crowd the panel edges, and the middle and right panels butt together with no gutter, so the lineup looks like a cramped collage.

The lob panel does not clearly show a 'layered lob ending below the jaw'; it reads as a wavy bob around jaw/collarbone length with weak layering, so the cut is hard to distinguish from the fringe cut.
The side-swept fringe cut is only mid-length layers, so the length and fringe contrast with the lob is weaker than the article purpose requires.

The same woman appears in all three panels with identical expression and pose, which can mislead readers into thinking the images show a real before/after transformation of one person rather than a style comparison.
The face shape looks soft and oval rather than clearly square, so the image does not convincingly demonstrate how each cut interacts with a square face.
